nodes.name: Check USDA Eligibility
nodes.notes: NOTE: This API endpoint is illustrative. USDA does not provide a public API. In production, you would need to scrape the eligibility map or use geocoding + manual rural area database.

nodes.name: Geocode Address
nodes.notes: Use Google Maps Geocoding API to get state and county

parameters.query: SELECT income_limit_1_4, income_limit_5_8 FROM usda_income_limits WHERE state = $1 AND county = $2 AND year = 2026

nodes.name: Get Income Limit
nodes.notes: Query PostgreSQL database with USDA income limits (scraped annually)

parameters.text: =Please see attached PDF report with your USDA loan eligibility results.
